title: Where we are

parts.explains: Run this in PowerShell 7 from the repo folder. It finds Node, builds the portal (about 1 minute), starts it on this computer only and opens http://127.0.0.1:3417/ in your browser.
In the portal, open P1 on the Roadmap and use the script buttons to read each task's check script and the gate script that decides when P1 is done.
Stops the portal when you are done. It only reads the plan, so nothing can change while it runs.
